item.title: Cenk Uygur backs Ro Khanna in 2028 race
item.description:
Ro Khanna hasn't launched a 2028 bid yet, but he already has a pioneer of the populist left in his corner. Progressive firebrand Cenk Uygur is set to formally endorse the California Democrat on Thursday night during his annual appearance on nephew Hasan Piker's Twitch stream, a Thanksgiving Day debate-a-thon the pair call "Cenksgiving." Uygur told POLITICO he will pitch Khanna as the best populist progressive candidate. His Rebellion PAC will also debut its first 2028 ad promoting a Khanna candidacy Thursday night. "For me, it's a no-brainer," Uygur said in an interview, explaining why he’s backing Khanna. "Who else would you back, and why would any progressive or any populist back anyone else?" Along with his PAC getting behind Khanna, Uygur is also launching his own "Draft Ro" website to collect signatures and showcase other early high-profile endorsers, though he wouldn't say who…

item.description:

ASML — which generates 2.2% of the Netherlands’ GDP — is the world’s sole manufacturer of the machines used for making cutting-edge chips.
